title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In August 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore off the old shingles down to the deck, laid new synthetic underlayment, and installed new GAF Timberline architectural shingles in dark gray, with new plastic roof vents, new vent pipe flashings and ridge cap.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old roof down to the wood deck
Laid Safeguard 30 hybrid underlayment over the deck
Installed new GAF Timberline architectural shingles with standard ridge cap
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic vents and put new double-seal flashings on the vent pipes
New painted drip edge and gable flashing, plus new front wall and sidewall flashing
